description: A `return` in an engine message arm (here `{ return }`) has no enclosing function: E-STMT-RETURN-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION, not a codegen crash.
rationale: §51.0.S.2.3: a message arm's value is the target state — a message arm is not a function body. §34: E-STMT-RETURN-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION, "`return` outside of a function". impl#1 emitted `return return;` and failed as E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC, a compiler-defect code that names nothing the author wrote (dpa-068 D10).
